Finite exact witnesses and a pencil test corroborate, without replacing, this proof.

value.rationale: Settles a natural structurally defined infinite singular-graph family of the active graph-versus-random-walk evolution-algebra question. Its intrinsic rigidity lemma classifies nonmonomial isomorphisms, and the rational cube obstruction identifies a substantive field dependence absent from real formulations. All complete multipartite and arbitrary invertible-base blowups are covered; the claim does not extrapolate to singular bases.
